title: Material Catalog - the Motes the dark sheds
note: 32 slots, index = SaveRecord.materials[] index. Drops are keyed to world location and story arc: early worlds shed common motes, the late worlds shed the rare ores. First Light leaves only the Archon's body.

materials.name: Dusk Shard
materials.desc: A splinter of the dark that the lowest Heartless sloughs when it dies. Nothing special, but the stall can make cold iron answer for it.

materials.name: Heart Fragment
materials.desc: A shard of a stolen heart, still warm. Tastes of the drowned islands. The Forge buys these by the fistful.

materials.name: Nobody Thread
materials.desc: Woven from the coat of a defeated Nobody. It refuses to unravel — which makes it excellent for binding.

materials.name: Clockwork Gear
materials.desc: Turned by Wonderland's forgetting-room. Each gear holds one second of someone else's time.

materials.name: Sunken Gold
materials.desc: Sand from the Cave of Wonders that remembers being treasure. Mallos hoards it; Zero collects it.

materials.name: Belly Rune
materials.desc: Etched by the acid of Monstro's stomach. It hums a swallowed sailor's lullaby.

materials.name: Stolen Song
materials.desc: A melody Yssora tore from Ariel's throat. The stall whistles it off-key and cups its hands around the note.

materials.name: Pumpkin Wax
materials.desc: Drippings from a hundred jack-o'-lanterns. The grin sewed its stitches through this.

materials.name: Hook Chain
materials.desc: A link of the captain's anchor chain, pulled from Neverland's tide. It weighs more than it should.

materials.name: Ink Leaf
materials.desc: A page torn from a storybook world. Whatever is written on it cannot be lied about.

materials.name: Piston Seal
materials.desc: A pressure seal from Ansem's machine heart. It still ticks in the Keyblade's rhythm.

materials.name: Pride Claw
materials.desc: The Hinge That Opens shed this like a nail. The Pride Lands' animals refuse to touch it out of respect.

materials.name: Dragon Scale
materials.desc: One scale from the thousand-mile stare's eye-wall. Warm like a forge that is always lit.

materials.name: Moon Shard
materials.desc: A crescent of the berserk moon, stolen by Saix's abandoned rage. It hums on every full phase.

materials.name: Gambler's Die
materials.desc: A six-sided lie. Luxord rolled it once and lost his own name; now it belongs to whoever throws it first.

materials.name: Void Smoke
materials.desc: The only thing that burns in the World That Never Was. It extinguishes light and remembers the shape of it.

materials.name: Witness Ash
materials.desc: Ash of the drowned shore where a boy drew a Keyblade in sand. It knows what being seen means.

materials.name: First Light
materials.desc: The Archon carried this before it carried the Door. The first light the dark ever ate. Only its own body drops it.

materials.name: Belled Metal
materials.desc: Cast from the great bells of sleeping castles. Rings once when a keyblade is near.

materials.name: Memory Chord
materials.desc: A tightened string of recollection, plucked from any Heartless soldier who half-remembers its past.
